verdict.rationale: Jan's privacy docs state that data collection is off by default and only starts with user consent. That opt-in posture means users are opted out unless they choose otherwise, but the pack never documents the actual control or what is collected. Missing for 10: a documented settings toggle to disable or revoke analytics/telemetry, a description of what usage data is collected when enabled, and independent or hands-on verification that no telemetry is sent by default.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: Zero data collection until you say so.
